results.remarks:
Welcome home to this beautifully designed mountain retreat, offering convenient level entry from Annandale Drive directly into the main living area. The thoughtfully designed main floor features a spacious living room, dining area, kitchen, and an impressive primary suite, creating comfortable single-level living.

Just outside the front entrance, a large deck provides additional outdoor living space—perfect for morning coffee, entertaining guests, or simply enjoying the peaceful mountain surroundings. Inside, abundant windows and skylights fill the home with natural light, creating a bright and inviting atmosphere throughout.

The spacious living room showcases a charming brick fireplace and seamlessly flows into the dining area, making it ideal for gatherings with family and friends. The kitchen is both functional and welcoming, featuring beautiful tile countertops, a center island, generous pantry storage, and easy access to the adjacent powder room and laundry area. The oversized two-car garage offers ample parking and storage, with windows that bring in additional natural light.

Privately situated off the living room, the primary suite is a true sanctuary. Surrounded by windows that capture the forest views, the suite features a luxurious bathroom complete with dual vanities, a large soaking tub, separate shower, and an additional oversized walk-in closet.

The lower level offers exceptional flexibility with a spacious family room anchored by a second fireplace, creating the perfect space for movie nights, game days, or relaxing after a day on the lake. Two additional bedrooms and a full bath provide comfortable accommodations for family and guests.

Also located downstairs is an expansive bonus room with endless possibilities. Whether envisioned as a fourth bedroom, game room, home office, fitness studio, hobby room, or media room, this versatile space can easily adapt to your lifestyle needs.

Step outside from the family room onto another private deck nestled among towering trees, providing a tranquil setting to enjoy the fresh mountain air and natural beauty.

Ideally located just minutes from the Lake Arrowhead Country Club and offering coveted lake rights, this exceptional property combines comfort, versatility, and the best of mountain living.

results.remarks: Freshly painted interior & new carpet!  Home is now vacant & ready to go!  Just a quick hop to the lake, UCLA conference center or out hwy 173 for some hiking or off-roading, this home offers the perfect location for all your needs.  Situated just above North Bay, (always plowed first in winter) this well cared for property has plenty of parking, even a 30 foot level pad for RV or a boat & is level entry!  The main level features a spacious living room with a rock fireplace, good size dining area & an updated kitchen with granite counters & stainless appliances. Roomy kitchen with lots of natural light & just adjacent to the laundry room & access to the garage. Once upstairs you will be greeted with vaulted ceilings & lots of natural light. One guest room has a spacious walk-in closet, the other that is being used as an office has a beautiful little alcove surrounded by windows to enjoy the views.  The 3rd is the primary suite with its own little deck, a walk-in closet, a gas fireplace & another full bathroom!  This home has been well maintained & recently had a full exterior paint job including the decks & railings.  There is a fenced dog run behind the house & access into the 2 car insulated garage from that area. Surrounded by lots of beautiful oak trees which will offer lots of shade in the summer but to keep you extra cool this home also has AC!  A great home for all seasons & ready to enjoy!

A half bath is conveniently located just off the entry.

Step outside to a view deck off the living room, ideal for entertaining, along with a front deck that provides a great space to relax in the evenings, complete with a fire pit. The home also offers level entry into a 2-car garage with direct access for added convenience during the winter months.

Just off the living room, above the garage, is a large family room that can easily serve as a guest space, game room, kids' space or flexible living area.

The lower level includes three bedrooms (1 is a master suite with double sinks and a full bath shower combo), two full bathrooms, and a laundry closet for convenience.

In addition, there is a permitted office/storage space with a half bath, accessed separately from the front porch by way of stairs leading to the side yard.

The property also features a fenced yard, offering space for kids and pets, lake rights for full access to the lake and country club for golf and tennis.

results.remarks:
Ideally situated in the sought-after Palisades area, this exceptional Lakeside Cottage offers the perfect blend of timeless mountain character, modern comfort, and an enviable location near the lake and Bob’s Beach.

Inside, dramatic vaulted tongue-and-groove ceilings create an impressive sense of space, complemented by rich hardwood floors, custom lighting, and a stunning floor-to-ceiling native stone fireplace with a custom live-edge mantel. Thoughtful architectural details include a floating staircase, built-in bookcase and display shelving, along with newer windows, doors, and hardware.

The heart of the home is its beautifully designed kitchen, featuring a large center island with counter seating, stainless steel appliances, hickory cabinetry with pull-out spice storage, and generous counter and shelf space. Open to the dining area and living spaces, the layout creates an inviting setting for everything from casual mountain meals to larger gatherings.

Two private ensuite bedrooms provide comfortable accommodations across both levels. The primary suite is conveniently located on the main level, while the upstairs ensuite offers added privacy for family or guests. Both bathrooms have been tastefully refreshed with oversized walk-in showers. A spacious loft/game room adds another versatile living area, ideal for games, movie nights, an office, additional sleeping space, or entertaining.

The outdoor spaces are equally appealing. A rear deck off the primary suite offers room for a private spa, while the fenced backyard features a fire pit, seating area, and BBQ space—creating a natural setting for relaxing and entertaining in the fresh mountain air.

Numerous updates enhance comfort and convenience, including air conditioning, a tankless water heater, fresh interior and exterior paint, newer windows and doors, and updated hardware. A level driveway and easy entry with only a few steps to the front door add to the home's accessibility. Three separate outdoor storage areas provide ample room for firewood, snow equipment, tools, sleds, and recreational gear.

The location puts you close to all that makes Lake Arrowhead special, including the lake, Bob’s Beach, Lake Arrowhead Village, and the dining and boutiques of Cedar Glen. 

Furnishings are included in the purchase price, subject to Seller inventory. A truly special Lake Arrowhead property ready to be enjoyed from day one.

Perched against the backdrop of the National Forest, this one-of-a-kind mountain retreat offers an unforgettable blend of breathtaking scenery, thoughtful updates, and eclectic design. Enjoy sweeping views of the Pinnacles, the high desert, Mt. Baldy, and spectacular sunset skies, all from the comfort of your own mountain sanctuary.
The main level is designed for effortless living, featuring a dramatic living room anchored by a stunning floor-to-ceiling rock fireplace and wrapped in walls of windows that blur the line between indoors and out. Surrounded by towering trees and natural beauty, you'll feel immersed in the forest from nearly every angle. Wide-plank oak flooring flows throughout the home, while the beautifully updated kitchen and bathrooms offer a fresh, modern touch.
Also on the main level are two comfortable bedrooms, a full bathroom, and access to the rear deck - an ideal setting for entertaining, or simply soaking in the peaceful surroundings.
Upstairs, a spacious loft serves as a playful third bedroom or flexible retreat. The lower level offers exceptional versatility with a generous family room featuring a second fireplace that easily doubles as a fourth sleeping area, along with an additional full bathroom - perfect for hosting family and guests.
Brimming with personality, the home's thoughtfully curated interiors feature bold designer wallpaper and unique finishes that create a memorable, inviting atmosphere. Offered furnished per the seller's inventory, it's ready to be enjoyed as a full-time residence, weekend escape, or successful vacation rental.
Additional highlights include level parking and near-level entry, low-maintenance vinyl siding, a durable metal roof, air conditioning for year-round comfort, coveted Lake Rights, location on a quiet cul-de-sac and direct access to miles of National Forest just beyond your backyard. Bold, modern, and unforgettable, 476 Annandale is a striking architectural masterpiece known locally as a "Flying W" - this iconic mid-century design is distinguished by its dramatic multi-gabled roofline, soaring vaulted ceilings, and walls of glass that create the feeling of living among the trees.
The upper level showcases an awe-inspiring living space defined by four soaring vaulted gables and spectacular walls of windows that flood the home with natural light while framing the surrounding woodland. An open-concept kitchen and living area create the perfect setting for entertaining or quiet evenings immersed in nature. A full bathroom and two expansive decks extend the living space outdoors, offering multiple places to relax and take in the peaceful forest views.
A sculptural spiral staircase leads to the lower level, where you'll find three comfortable bedrooms, a second full bathroom, a laundry area, and an inviting patio tucked beneath the trees.
Modern conveniences include a mini-split air conditioning system, while coveted lake rights provide access to the beauty the lake has to offer. results.remarks:
Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully designed — now with new decking throughout the entrance and main level — this spacious two-story residence in Lake Arrowhead's Arrowhead Woods neighborhood offers the space, flexibility, and setting that define elevated mountain living. With 4 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and 1 half bath, the home blends comfort and functionality with a layout that lives beautifully year-round.

Natural light fills the main living areas, where expansive windows frame peaceful tree views and create a seamless connection to the surrounding forest. The open flow between kitchen, dining, and living spaces makes everyday living feel effortless while providing the perfect backdrop for gathering with friends and family after a day on the lake or the trails.

The kitchen anchors the home with a breakfast bar in the island, opening naturally into the main entertaining spaces. Generously sized bedrooms offer comfort and privacy, including a desirable main-level primary ensuite for ease and separation, plus a second ensuite bedroom on the lower level — ideal for guests, extended family, or multigenerational living. Additional bedrooms give family members room to spread out while keeping shared spaces easy to gather in.

A charming reading nook adds warmth and architectural character, while the flexible floor plan supports a dedicated home office, creative studio, fitness space, or additional lounge — ideal for today's evolving lifestyle needs.

The lower level, with its own separate entrance, offers real versatility: an enclosed room with electricity already run and durable sheet-metal interior walls, currently used for storage, with potential for future expansion (buyer to verify feasibility with the county).

Set in peaceful Arrowhead Woods, the property reflects consistent pride of ownership and offers a rare combination of livability, condition, and long-term flexibility.

This property carries lake rights, giving you optional access — with an ALA membership — to lakeside trails, private beach clubs, and boat dock rights, and the opportunity to fully embrace the lake lifestyle. A privately owned deepwater multi-slip dock is also available for purchase outside escrow — please inquire for details.

Schedule your private tour today and experience mountain living at its best on Grizzly Rd.

results.remarks: Lake Rights Home set on one of the most highly coveted and desirable streets in Lake Arrowhead. A short stroll to the pristine golf course, 410 Bel Air is a truly special residence that masterfully blends timeless mountain elegance with modern luxury. From the moment you arrive, the exceptional craftsmanship and sophisticated design of this four-bedroom, three-bathroom home will captivate you. The grand entry sets a dramatic tone, highlighted by a breathtaking, custom spiral wooden staircase. This entry leads into main living spaces that flow seamlessly into a stunning sunroom. Flooded with natural light, this sun-drenched space perfectly bridges indoor comfort with the beauty of nature, offering the perfect sanctuary to sip your morning coffee or unwind with a good book. Throughout the home, thoughtful architectural details elevate every room, while expansive windows frame peaceful, panoramic views of the lush, towering forest. The outdoor living spaces are just as impressive, starting with a large wrap-around deck that features a dedicated dog run for your furry companions. Upstairs, the main bedroom suite serves as a private retreat, complete with gorgeous coffered ceilings and its own private deck. The crown jewel of the interior is the spectacular third-floor bedroom retreat, which is wrapped in beautiful, warm tongue-and-groove woodwork. This expansive, versatile space captures the quintessential "vintage lake" warmth and boasts two private decks, making it an ideal family room, executive home office, or ultimate getaway spot. Beyond its beautiful design, this home offers modern comfort and substantial utility. It comes fully equipped with central air conditioning, an oversized, 800-square-foot garage; ample space for multiple vehicles, a golf cart, lake toys, or a workshop. Whether you are looking for a refined full-time residence or a luxurious mountain getaway, this property offers an unmatched lifestyle of privacy, prestige, and natural beauty.

results.remarks: Recent price reduction! In the highly desirable Palisades neighborhood on storied John Muir Road, this First Tier retreat is upgraded in every detail and sits on a lake front street with lake rights and coveted peeks of the water, a rare blend of legacy location and effortless walkability. Adding to the rarity: a two-car garage plus generous driveway parking (room for multiple vehicles), giving you the convenience that is desired in Lake Arrowhead. Step through the charming Dutch door into soaring ceilings, rich wood beams, and a massive stone fireplace that instantly sets a mountain tone. The main level is an open-concept living room, breakfast nook, and kitchen connect seamlessly, wrapped in windows that pull in forest views. The primary suite on the main floor feels like a private sanctuary with multiple closets and a spa-inspired bath featuring a dual vanity and deep soaking tub, plus its own private deck—perfect for quiet mornings in the trees. Upstairs, two more bedrooms, one with double bunks—ideal for hosting family and friends. With three bathrooms, ceiling fans in every bedroom, and an upstairs interior laundry room with newer washer/dryer, the home is designed to be as comfortable as it is memorable. The recently renovated wraparound deck is surrounded by mature trees, ideal setting for starry-night dinners, coffee, or après-snow gatherings. Thoughtful details—automatic sensor lighting for safe evening strolls, a gas line to the grill, and a dedicated custom made bear box at the end of the driveway. The kitchen is a standout: designer finishes, soft-close cabinetry, custom lighting and chandeliers, and a Wedgewood retro gas stove, paired with stainless appliances and every amenity you want for weekends (and extended stays). Offered fully furnished, this home delivers a true “arrive-and-enjoy” experience—high-end décor and furnishings down to the details, an 8-person dining table, oversized sectional, flat-screen TVs, shuffleboard, lake toys, and even a built-in air compressor/automatic pump for inflatables and tires. There is a newer central A/C with Nest controls, tankless water heater, wood-trim windows, a large basement storage area sized for all the lake toys. Whether you’re looking for a soulful lake escape, a full-time luxury retreat, or a proven investment with strong short-term rental appeal, this is the kind of Lake Arrowhead opportunity that rarely comes along.

results.remarks:
From the very first step inside, the world outside instantly fades away - replaced by a deep, unmistakable sense of warmth. You instantly feel right at home! Welcome to The Nest. Under soaring cathedral ceilings bathed in streaming natural light, this magnificent 2,695-square-foot sanctuary offers an effortless harmony of timeless character and modern luxury. With a whole house Generac Generator too, newer windows, furnaces and a whole house water filtration system, this home is perfect for full or part time mountain living with Pride Of Ownership evident around every single corner. 

Rich brick flooring underfoot tells a story of craftsmanship and heart, anchoring a layout filled with soul and charm at every turn. At the center of daily life is the thoughtfully remodeled chef’s kitchen with a show-stopping Quartz island designed for some serious entertaining and laid back gathering where morning coffee seamlessly turns into evening laughter, baking batches of sweet treats, and sharing meals with those who matter most. 

Step through onto the sweeping wrap-around deck, where gentle mountain breezes and sweet morning birdsong greet you each day. Look out over your stunning scenic views, stretching across nearly half an acre of extraordinarily rare, level mountain land. This is a gentle, flat haven near Grass Valley Lake that offers endless room to play, garden, gather, and breathe.

As night falls, melt into the warmth of the private outdoor hot tub under a canopy of mountain stars, listening to the delicious sound of the wind rustling through the trees. More than just a house, this is a place to love, to cherish, and where happy memories will be made and remembered forever.

results.remarks: Set among towering pines on coveted West Shore, this modern mountain retreat feels tucked away, quiet, and thoughtfully designed. Offered as a co-ownership by Pacaso, this professionally managed, turnkey home allows you to own one-eighth, giving you access to true lakefront living at a fraction of the cost. Expansive decking set in the trees, warm layered interiors, and walls of glass frame the surrounding landscape and catch glimpses of the lake beyond. On the main level, oversized sliding doors open the living space directly to a wraparound deck, creating an easy, natural flow for morning coffee, long dinners, and evenings in the trees. Just below, a gentle path leads to the shoreline, lake trail, a park-like setting for outdoor activities, and your private single-slip dock, close enough to make lake days feel effortless. Vaulted ceilings, a statement stone fireplace, and sunlit living spaces define the main level, while the primary suite offers beamed ceilings and an en suite bath. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms and a full bath provide space for guests. Downstairs, a second living space with its own fireplace, wet bar, and an oversized bunk room becomes the go-to spot for movie nights, hosting, or a full house. Doors open to a covered patio made for slow evenings and easy entertaining, while the tucked away hot tub deck offers a more private moment, set among the trees with soft views toward the water. A two-car garage with interior stairs leading down to the home adds a layer of ease, especially in the winter months. Located in Arrowhead Woods with lake rights, and just moments from hiking, biking, skiing, and year-round recreation, this is what Lake Arrowhead living is all about. A rare opportunity to experience West Shore lakefront, done right.

Welcome to one of the most coveted locations in Skyforest — “the Loop.” This fully remodeled 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,524 sq. ft. of modern living space across two levels, plus a 350 sq. ft. finished build-up on the lower level.

Situated on an expansive 1.19-acre, street-to-street lot, this property gives you the feeling of owning your own private forest. Every window frames a beautiful view of towering trees, with brilliant seasonal color changes and California mountain dogwoods scattered throughout the property.

Features & Upgrades
Completely remodeled – brand new inside and out
Three oversized bedrooms | 2 bathrooms | 1,524 sq. ft. + 350 sq. ft. finished build-up
Two-story floor plan with spacious, open-concept living
Wrap-around main deck plus two additional decks – perfect for entertaining or enjoying tree-top views
Massive walk-in closets in upstairs bedrooms with brand-new cabinetry and custom clothing storage systems
Extremely rare 3-step entry – easy, convenient access that few mountain homes can match
Expansive paved private parking with space for 10+ vehicles — ideal for boats, smaller RVs, and hosting many guests with ease
Only 2 minutes from Highway 18 for quick, convenient access on or off the mountain via Hwy 18 or 330
Street-to-street lot offering privacy and unique property layout
All major appliances new within the last 3-4 years — refrigerator, chest freezers, water heater, central heater, oven, and microwave
Currently fully furnished – furnishings negotiable
County-maintained and plowed roads – year-round access and peace of mind during winter months
Located in the exclusive Skyforest Loop neighborhood
 
Location & Lifestyle
Just minutes from Lake Arrowhead Village for dining, shopping, and entertainment, and a short drive to Heaps Peak Arboretum for beautiful forest trails and outdoor adventures. This home offers the perfect blend of privacy and accessibility — ideal for full-time living, a weekend retreat, or a lucrative vacation rental.

Why You’ll Love This Home
With over an acre of land, you’re not just buying a home — you’re claiming a private mountain sanctuary. Enjoy forest views from every room, brilliant fall foliage, and blooming mountain dogwoods in the spring. Move in and experience the peace and privacy that few homes on the mountain can offer.

Welcome to 788 Crown Dr, a fully remodeled, turnkey mountain retreat in the heart of Lake Arrowhead offering lake rights, comfort, and versatility.
This 4-bedroom, 3-bath home sits on a spacious 10,800 sq ft corner lot and has been thoughtfully upgraded to combine modern finishes with classic mountain charm. Inside offers vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light create an open, inviting feel, while the main living area features a cozy fireplace and seamless flow into the kitchen and dining space ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. This home is being offered fully furnished and equipped, making it move-in ready for a full-time residence or second home. Central A/C throughout which is rare for the area adds year-round comfort.

The garage is currently set up as a game room, providing a flexible bonus space perfect for entertaining, a home gym, or additional living area, with the option to easily convert it back to a traditional garage if desired. Currently operating as a short-term rental with management in place, the property also offers optional income potential for those looking to offset ownership costs.

Located in a desirable area of Lake Arrowhead with year-round appeal from snowy winters to sunny lake days this home offers the ideal balance of lifestyle, comfort, and flexibility. Come experience the best of Lake Arrowhead.

results.remarks: LAKE RIGHTS! Just across the way from the lake front access point and or launch your boat at the marina. Private, secluded, gated, peaceful, serene, quiet. Just past the clubhouse at the top of the community at the very end on the left. Plenty of parking spaces directly in front of the house with a small pathway of steps leading down to the front door. Move in ready turn-key condition. 2 giant master suites with one on the main level and the other downstairs just a few steps down to the 2nd master suite and a 2nd living room fireplace family room with a giant outdoor deck looking over a take your breath away view of the open tranquil land with trees and a delightful view with the afternoon sun! Up-stairs 3rd bedroom with giant closet space and or den, loft, office space. Head on down to the basement that is not finished out, but the space is there! Vaulted ceilings, 2 sliders up-stairs for added natural sunlight, gorgeous, engineered hardwood floors, designer low plush carpet, natural slate floors a perfect complement to the incredible granite counter tops. Fine woodworking and every attention to detail. The drive up to the home is incredibly stately, and this is one of the finest communities in Lake Arrowhead. This is not part of a time share and there are only a total of 5 units here at this specific location. Our HOA fee is only $150.00 for the newly created HOA and so little yet for so much. Just a short stroll over to the 2 tennis courts, indoor pool, corporate meeting rooms, gym, pool table room, spa and recreation room. There are additional walking paths, and the atmosphere is really more like a resort than just a community. Resort living at its finest.  Stainless steel appliances and the tax roll says this was built in 1993 but it was actually built in 2009 to 2010.  Such an incredible investment. So close to LA international airport or Palm Springs Airport. less than an hour to Claremont Colleges and Mt. Baldy is just 45 minutes away. Come home to Lake Arrowhead where your at home away from home.  So close! Separate interior laundry room and refrigerator and washer and dryer included.  Furniture negotiable!

results.remarks: Connect with nature in this level-entry, move-in-ready, fully furnished mountain retreat with a touch of Mountain BOHO. This inviting Lake Arrowhead home blends rustic charm, relaxed style, and thoughtful upgrades. From the moment you step inside, you'll feel right at home. The warm, welcoming atmosphere invites you to settle in and enjoy the relaxed mountain lifestyle. Vaulted cathedral ceilings create an airy sense of space, while a beautiful fireplace framed by custom bookcases serves as the heart of the living area. **Remote-controlled ceiling fans in every bedroom and air conditioning provide year-round comfort.** Offering level parking, fully furnished interiors, a whole-house water filtration system, and approximately 1,881 square feet of living space, this 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home features two fireplaces. Just off the dining area, a spacious deck extends your living space outdoors—perfect for morning coffee, gathering with family and friends, or simply taking in the peaceful mountain setting. Large windows showcase tranquil views of the surrounding trees, mountains, and distant desert, bringing nature indoors throughout every season. The fully fenced, two-tiered backyard offers space to garden, relax on starry nights, or enjoy time with pets, embracing the easygoing Mountain-inspired BOHO lifestyle. Adventure is always close by with **LAKE PRIVILEGES!** Enjoy nearby Lake Arrowhead for boating, fishing, and lakeside recreation, or spend the day at the nearby golf course and country club. Hiking trails, off-road adventures, and local ski resorts are all within easy reach, making every season an opportunity to explore. Additional highlights include boat parking, an attached garage, and generous guest parking. Whether you're searching for a full-time residence, a weekend getaway, a vacation home, or an investment opportunity, this one-of-a-kind mountain escape offers the perfect blend of character, comfort, and the relaxed spirit of Lake Arrowhead living. Ideal for buyers seeking a serene, stylish, nature-inspired lifestyle with excellent potential as an income-producing mountain property.

results.remarks: Built in 1928, 255 Hemlock Drive is a soulful Lake Arrowhead retreat where nearly a century of mountain history meets thoughtful modern living. Tucked beneath towering trees, this one-of-a-kind home feels deeply connected to its surroundings and the history of this mountain community. The home’s story lives in its original craftsmanship. Custom French-style doors and windows, period hardware, and a magnificent fireplace built from locally quarried stone have been carefully preserved and restored—details whose warmth and character have been earned through nearly 100 years of mountain life. At the heart of the home is the soaring cathedral-ceiling living room, both dramatic and inviting. Sunlight streams through French-style windows and doors, while an arched leaded-glass window draws the eye upward. The original stone fireplace anchors the room, creating a natural gathering place for snowy evenings and quiet mornings. Overhead, custom metal collar ties, designed with a local metalsmith to support mountain snow loads while maintaining the room’s openness, embody the philosophy behind the restoration: honor the soul of the 1928 home while allowing it to live beautifully today. That openness continues into the airy primary suite, where a vaulted ceiling, exposed wood rafters and slender metal collar ties create a peaceful retreat. Natural light and warm wood details lend an understated serenity, with generous proportions for unwinding after a day in the mountains. Equally inviting is the light-filled bunk room, designed for the way a mountain home is meant to be shared. Surrounded by windows and framed by exposed beams, it offers multiple sleeping areas and room to lounge and play—ideal for children, extended family and weekend guests. Throughout, old and new coexist beautifully. Locally saw-milled wide-plank pine floors meet custom metalwork, including seven-foot French-style garden doors and handcrafted stair railings. A salvaged 1920s eight-foot-wide leaded-glass kitchen window adds another piece of history, while a Bertazzoni range and heated custom marble bathroom floors bring modern comfort and luxury. Outside, mature trees and foliage embrace the double lot, while weathered cedar shingles and warm wood siding evoke the timeless character of an early mountain retreat. Above all, 255 Hemlock Drive has been lovingly cared for as a piece of Lake Arrowhead history.

Nestled among the pines in the desirable Deer Lodge Park neighborhood of Lake Arrowhead, this well-maintained 4-bedroom, 2-bath home offers approximately 1,850 square feet of comfortable living space on an 8,494 square foot lot. 

The open-concept main level is filled with natural light from large windows that bring the outdoors in. The spacious living room features a cozy fireplace, creating the perfect gathering space during every season. The beautifully remodeled kitchen has been thoughtfully updated with quality finishes, a gas range, modern appliances, and a convenient indoor laundry area, all flowing seamlessly into the dining space for easy everyday living and entertaining.

Both bathrooms have been meticulously remodeled with exceptional attention to detail, offering a clean, timeless design that complements the home's mountain character. All four bedrooms are generously sized, providing comfortable accommodations for family and guests.

Downstairs, you'll find an inviting second living space centered around a charming freestanding wood-burning stove, creating the perfect setting for relaxing after a day on the trails or enjoying the snow. 

Climate control is a breeze with central AC and heat to warm those frosty toes or cool down after a mountain hike! 

Enjoy the peaceful mountain setting from the spacious rear decks located on both levels of the home. Built with low-maintenance Trex-style composite decking, these outdoor living spaces are designed for lasting durability and resistance to moisture, making them ideal for year-round enjoyment.

An added bonus is the plowed road access during the winter months, providing reliable year-round accessibility when snow arrives.

If you've been searching for a move-in ready mountain home with beautifully remodeled interiors, multiple indoor and outdoor living spaces, and an excellent Lake Arrowhead location, this property is one you won't want to miss.

barely waits for you to get out of the car. Level entry, plenty of parking, and a polished exterior that
stands out against the forest: the easy stuff is handled before you're even inside.

Climb up to the small loft and you get a bonus sleeping spot plus the best seat in the house for admiring
the A-frame's symmetry. The bedrooms sit cozy, but laid out so nobody feels cramped.

Charming and contemporary. Brilliantly built with a one-of-a-kind atmosphere for your tour.

results.remarks: Rustic character meets modern polish in this beautifully updated Lake Arrowhead home with full lake rights. Set directly across from the Lake Arrowhead Country Club and minutes from National Forest trails, this property puts boating, fishing, swimming, hiking, and easy commuter access all within reach. The main level welcomes you with an open layout anchored by a striking stone fireplace in the living room, flowing into a generous dining area built for gathering. The upgraded kitchen pairs high-end appliances with smart design—equally suited to weeknight dinners and weekend entertaining. A well-appointed, main-level bedroom and full bath round out this floor with added flexibility for guests. Upstairs, the primary suite is a genuine retreat: vaulted beamed ceilings, a second stone fireplace, a sitting area, and a private deck overlooking the mountain air. A second bedroom and impeccably finished bathroom share this level with the primary bedroom. Downstairs, the finished lower level is an entertainer’s dream. Wraparound couches, custom artwork, and tasteful décor create a lounge-ready atmosphere, while a mounted 72-inch television with state-of-the-art surround sound turns movie nights and game days into an experience. It’s the kind of space guests never want to leave. Practical details haven’t been overlooked —a two-car garage, ample guest parking, air conditioning, and a tankless water heater keep the home running efficiently year-round. Tastefully maintained and thoughtfully upgraded, this is Lake Arrowhead living at its best—lake privileges and furnishings included and the memories are yours to make.

results.remarks:
This lake rights home is designed for easy living and effortless enjoyment of the mountain lifestyle. A level parking deck and level entry make arrival convenient, while the covered front porch welcomes you into the home.
Inside, the open-concept living area features a vaulted ceiling and walls of windows that fill the space with natural light and showcase the surrounding views. Beautiful hickory engineered hardwood floors flow throughout the main living areas, complemented by warm hickory kitchen cabinetry and adorable bear-themed hardware for a quintessential mountain touch. A cozy fireplace anchors the living room, while fire sprinklers and dual-pane windows add thoughtful convenience and peace of mind.
All three bedrooms are located downstairs, creating a comfortable and private sleeping level. The primary bedroom features its own en-suite bathroom and private deck, offering a peaceful spot to step outside and enjoy the mountain setting. Two additional bedrooms share a second full bathroom. The laundry is conveniently located on the same level as the bedrooms.
There are multiple spaces for taking in the scenery, including the back deck and an outdoor seating area in the yard - perfect for morning coffee, evening gatherings, or simply relaxing in the fresh mountain air. And with lake rights, you can enjoy all that the Lake Arrowhead lifestyle has to offer. Recent upgrades include newer roof (2024), kitchen cabinets & counters & appliances (2023), newer washer dryer (2025), interior paint (2026), and the upstairs windows have been replaced.
With its level access, air conditioning, beautiful natural finishes, abundant windows, multiple outdoor spaces, and inviting mountain character, 1208 Aleutian is a wonderful place to call home or your mountain getaway.

results.remarks:
Nestled in the historic Arrowhead Villas area of Lake Arrowhead, this 1,789-square-foot, fully furnished and renovated mountain home is the ultimate turnkey family retreat. Designed for peaceful mountain living and multi-generational comfort, the residence features 4 bedrooms and 2.5 baths across three thoughtfully laid out levels, plus a detached, fully remodeled Studio/Loft with a modern bi-fold door—ideal for a private home office, creative space, or guest suite.
Situated across 2 spacious lots, the property boasts grade-level parking for up to 4 vehicles and plenty of room to explore, complete with fresh apples and blackberries growing right on the lot. The main level welcomes you with an inviting living and dining area, a main-floor bedroom, a full bath, and an updated kitchen complete with butcher block countertops and stainless-steel appliances. Upstairs offers two additional cozy bedrooms and a remodeled half bath, while the lower level features a large bedroom, full bath, laundry room, and generous storage.
High-end upgrades and peace of mind flow throughout, including a BRAND-NEW ROOF (June 2026) with a 10-year transferable warranty, a 1300W portable power generator, dual-pane Milgard windows, solid-core doors, a spacious redwood deck, and full smart-home integration (Nest cameras, video doorbell, smart thermostat, and surround sound).
While perfectly suited as a move-in ready personal sanctuary, the home comes fully equipped with optional established management and cleaning services in place if you wish to host short-term guests. Arrowhead Villas features its own mutual water system (approx. $80/month paid quarterly), which covers water, snow removal (one of the first streets plowed), trash, and road maintenance. Located just minutes from the lake, shops, and local dining—don't miss this Lake Arrowhead gem!

results.remarks:
This stunning, move-in ready Thunderbird-style home is ideally situated in one of Lake Arrowhead’s most desirable neighborhoods, just minutes from the shops and restaurants of Blue Jay. Thoughtfully reimagined in 2020, the home blends elevated mountain living with timeless design, featuring walnut-blasted ceilings, hickory wood floors, and curated designer finishes throughout.
Offering level entry into the main living space, the home welcomes you with vaulted ceilings and a striking river rock fireplace as the centerpiece of the living room. A sliding glass door opens to the expansive Trex deck, rebuilt in 2021, creating a private outdoor retreat surrounded by mature trees and exceptional privacy.
The light-filled kitchen and dining area flow seamlessly from the living room and feature a dual-fuel ILVE 5-burner range, forest green cabinetry, crisp white honed marble countertops, and a built-in wine refrigerator.
Also on the main level is a beautifully designed guest bedroom featuring William Morris wallpaper, along with a luxurious full bath complete with marble floors, a Zuma soaking tub, and handcrafted Zellige tile.
Downstairs, a versatile den/game room is flanked by two well-appointed bedrooms and an additional full bathroom, offering flexible space for guests, entertaining, or relaxing weekends in the mountains.
Recent upgrades include a brand-new whole house generator, upgraded electrical panel, electric vehicle charger, tankless water heater, and brand-new LG washer and dryer. Additional improvements include updated furnace and air conditioning systems, making this home truly turnkey for full-time living or weekend escapes alike.
Complete with coveted lake rights, this sophisticated mountain retreat offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and year-round enjoyment. Select furnishings may be available separately.

results.remarks:
Retro vibes and forest views create the peaceful mountain ambiance of this 3 bedroom, 3 bathroom Lake Arrowhead home. 
Practical mountain living is well covered: a whole-house generator for peace of mind during outages, a split-system AC in multiple rooms for summer comfort, a two-car carport, and a fully fenced backyard. Lake rights grant access to private Lake Arrowhead for swimming, boating, fishing, and ALA beaches and trails (membership required).
Step into the impressive great room, where a dramatic prow ceiling of warm knotty pine rises above a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace. The unique architecture flows into the open concept kitchen and dining area with built-in shelving and additional slider to the deck. The main floor also offers a bedroom, full bathroom, and game room with brick fireplace.
The lower level contains another living area, offering a more intimate gathering spot perfect for movie nights. Two en-suite bedrooms and bathrooms are also found on this level, with two additional smaller rooms that can be used as an office or storage space. Access to the fully fenced and landscaped backyard can be found through the lower floor living area. Here you can relax on the outdoor swing, kids can play on the custom playground, or pets can roam the property.
Ideal as a full-time home, weekend escape, or vacation retreat - this residence blends classic mountain character with everyday comfort!

results.remarks:
There’s a certain magic to a true A-frame—an architectural form that feels both nostalgic and enduring, where design and nature exist in perfect harmony. At 348 Brentwood Drive, that magic is fully realized.

Set beneath a canopy of towering pines on one of Lake Arrowhead’s most coveted streets, this timeless retreat captures the essence of authentic mountain living. Backing directly to the National Forest, the property offers a rare sense of privacy and connection to nature—where deer wander through your backyard, birdsong fills the air, and every season brings a new, ever-changing landscape.

Wrapped in rich tongue-and-groove wood detailing, the home unfolds with warmth and intention. Soaring vaulted ceilings and a dramatic wall of glass define the main living space, inviting natural light to pour in while framing the surrounding forest like a living work of art. The open-concept design seamlessly connects the living room, dining area, and kitchen—creating an atmosphere that feels both expansive and intimate. A statement fireplace anchors the room, offering the quintessential cabin experience for cozy winter nights and effortless entertaining.

Above, a lofted level overlooks the great room, providing a flexible retreat—ideal as a reading lounge, creative space, or additional sleeping quarters for guests.

The lower level introduces a more relaxed, social energy—a dedicated game and lounge space complete with its own fireplace and wet bar. Designed for connection and entertainment, this level offers the perfect setting for hosting, unwinding, and creating lasting memories.

Step outside to an elevated deck that feels suspended within the trees, where mornings begin with coffee in the crisp mountain air and evenings unfold beneath a canopy of stars. The expansive, tree-studded lot enhances the home’s sense of seclusion while maintaining close proximity to everything Lake Arrowhead has to offer.

Function meets lifestyle with a rare and highly desirable parking experience. A long, U-shaped driveway provides exceptional space—easily accommodating multiple vehicles, a pontoon boat, and additional guest parking, an uncommon luxury in the mountains.

Ideally located just moments from Lake Arrowhead Country Club and inclusive of coveted lake rights, this home offers seamless access to golf, lake days, and village living.

Nestled among towering pines & majestic oaks on a wooded half-acre lot in Lake Arrowhead’s prestigious Summit neighborhood, this custom-built home with coveted LAKE RIGHTS offers the perfect blend of mountain charm, comfort, & versatility. Lovingly maintained by the original owners, the property features spacious interiors, abundant natural light & peaceful forest surroundings.

The main level includes an office/study with custom built-in bookshelves, formal dining room, and spacious kitchen with an island, walk-in pantry, abundant cabinetry, & sunny breakfast nook. The living room features a floor-to-ceiling brick wood-burning fireplace and a wall of windows that brings the outdoors in. Sliding glass doors from the living room and kitchen open to an expansive deck perfect for outdoor dining & relaxing among the trees.

Upstairs, the spacious loft includes an artist’s studio with a utility sink & built-in cabinetry, plus additional flex space ideal for a game room, fitness area or creative retreat.

The lower level hosts the primary suite with deck access, walk-in closet, & ensuite bath with soaking tub & separate shower. Three additional spacious bedrooms, a full bathroom, & laundry room provide comfortable accommodations for family and guests.

The fully finished basement has been transformed into a private studio apartment with its own entrance, ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or rental income potential. Features include a fireplace, kitchenette, French-inspired bathroom, surround sound speakers, & sliding glass doors leading to a private outdoor area with peaceful forest views. Currently operating as a successful short-term rental, this versatile space offers excellent income potential.

Adjacent to the studio is a woodworking/workshop area with a garage-style door.

Additional highlights are a level-entry driveway, attached two-car garage, EV Charger, hardwood floors throughout, solar panel system, and central vacuum system.

Located on a very quiet county-maintained road in a convenient commuter location, this exceptional home is situated in the highly sought-after Summit neighborhood, known for its upscale homes on spacious half-acre or more parcels and underground utilities.

In springtime, the front yard comes alive with colorful tulips and daffodils.

Owned & cherished by one family since its construction, this special mountain retreat offers a rare opportunity in one of Lake Arrowhead’s most desirable neighborhoods.

results.remarks: A timeless architectural retreat where classic A-frame design meets elevated modern living. Thoughtfully reimagined while honoring its iconic mid-century character, this beautifully updated A-frame offers an exceptional mountain lifestyle framed by soaring architecture and captivating treetop views. Perfectly positioned between the endless trails of the National Forest and the coveted north shore of Lake Arrowhead, this home includes full lake rights, placing year-round recreation just moments away. The classic silhouette is complemented by a durable metal roof, while dramatic vaulted ceilings, exposed beams, and expansive walls of glass flood the interior with natural light and showcase the home's natural surroundings. At the heart of the living room, a luxurious chocolate-brown Malm-style wood-burning fireplace anchors the space, creating an inviting focal point for cozy evenings after a day on the lake or trails. Significant aspect of the home have been thoughtfully curated with designer finishes that blend warmth, sophistication, and functionality. The main level features two generously sized bedrooms, a beautifully renovated full bath, and an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area designed for effortless entertaining and everyday comfort. Upstairs, the spacious loft functions as a private primary retreat, offering flexible lounge and office space, a king-sized bed, a walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired ensuite bath showcasing refined designer updates. Newly installed high end sliding glass doors open to a secluded private deck, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee among the pines or quiet evenings beneath the stars. The remodeled lower level adds valuable versatility with a dedicated laundry room, abundant storage, and convenient space for outdoor gear—including canoe storage for effortless lake adventures. Whether you're searching for a full-time mountain residence, a weekend escape, or an investment opportunity, this meticulously updated A-frame offers a rare combination of architectural significance, modern comfort, and an unbeatable Lake Arrowhead location. Classic design. Thoughtful updates. Iconic mountain living.

results.remarks: Anomaly: something that is unusual or unexpected; a rarity, an exception. This perfectly describes the quiet little cabin at 1384 Golden Rule. There’s not another house like this on the mountain…or maybe anywhere! The original owners, second to the current owners, are the ones that conceptualized, designed and built their dream cabin. They were dreamers, lovers of travel and art, all which they built into their cabin. The current owners saw that uniqueness, and knew that they could take what was there to the next level. The ceilings and walls of warm cedar are original as are the fireplace and reading nook next to it. Wrapped in stone with a metal hook, the fireplace will keep you cozy and warm in the winter. And the most original elephant in the room is the glass ceiling…certainly not the kind you want to break through! The more-than-a-skylight is a large portion of the roof ridge that is all glass, flooding the house with dappled natural light. A wall between kitchen and living area was removed to house a new gorgeous kitchen with quartz counters and a giant island with dining on the living room side. The kitchen has an enourmous amount of storage. There’s a built in nook with bench and table for 6 with a backdrop of windows. The living space also includes a large bay window for even more view and light as well. The two bedrooms are a perfect size with a loft area in each for home office or kid space. A large bathroom with dual sinks and tub/shower is conveniently located near both bedrooms. A very large deck overlooks a natural ravine that turns into an active stream in the winter. The deck has built-in container gardening boxes, and there’s gorgeous new gazebo for outdoor dining. Down the stairs from the back deck is space that could be made into another bedroom and bath. Are you ready to explore this unique anomaly, maybe make it your own?

results.remarks: Welcome to Your Mountain Retreat  A-Frame Perfection with Lake Rights.      Tucked into the pines just minutes from Lake Arrowhead, this beautifully updated A-frame captures everything a mountain escape should be -- privacy, panoramic views, and true seclusion, all just a short drive from the lake. With coveted lake rights and a strong rental history, this home is as smart an investment as it is a retreat.     From the moment you step inside, open sky and sweeping forest views set the tone. High vaulted ceilings and a cozy fireplace anchor the open-concept living space, while the kitchen flows effortlessly into the main living area, designed for gathering, unwinding, and making the most of mountain life.      With five spacious bedrooms (including a bunkroom perfect for guests) and a large downstairs den, there's room for everyone to spread out without feeling on top of one another. Whether you're hosting family, friends, or welcoming rental guests, the layout offers a flexibility that's rare in a home this size.     No detail was overlooked in the home's 2021 remodel. New flooring, a fully remodeled bathroom, and a long list of tasteful upgrades bring modern comfort into this home while preserving the timeless charm and character of true A-frame design. Generous closets, ample cabinetry, and plenty of parking round out the thoughtful layout.     Step outside onto the wrap-around deck, where mountain air and quiet surroundings feel worlds away from everyday life. Follow it to your own private hot tub, tucked into the trees -- the perfect spot to soak in the stars on a clear mountain night.    This special home is used by family as well as a successful short-term rental. The property can be delivered fully furnished. A rare turnkey opportunity in the Lake Arrowhead mountains. A full list of seller upgrades is available upon request.

results.remarks: Just steps from Grass Valley Lake, this classic Thunderbird is a standout example of one of Lake Arrowhead's most beloved architectural styles. Soaring ceilings, exposed beams, knotty pine, a dramatic wall of glass, and a striking antler chandelier create an unforgettable first impression. Natural light pours into the living spaces, highlighting the home's architectural character and connection to its surroundings. The main living area centers around a beautiful fireplace, offering a warm and inviting space to gather after a day on the lake, the golf course, or nearby trails. Rich wood accents and timeless mountain details evoke the feeling of a private lodge, while the thoughtful floor plan offers comfort and flexibility for everyday living or weekend escapes. The kitchen and dining area are well positioned for both casual meals and entertaining, creating a natural flow between the home's gathering spaces. A bedroom and full bath on the main level add convenience and flexibility, while downstairs, two additional bedrooms, a second full bath, and a secondary living area create an ideal setup for guests, extended family, or multi-generational living. Outside, two spacious decks extend the living space outdoors, offering front row seats to crisp mountain mornings, golden hour sunsets, and star filled evenings. Whether hosting friends for a summer barbecue or enjoying a quiet cup of coffee, these generous outdoor spaces provide the perfect place to slow down and take in the surroundings. Below, a seasonal creek winds through the property, adding a peaceful natural element and the soothing sound of running water during the wetter months. Set on approximately one third of an acre, the property offers a rare sense of space with room to further enhance the grounds or explore future possibilities. Desirable level parking and coveted lake rights add everyday convenience. Ideally located just steps from Grass Valley Lake and moments from the golf course and country club, the home places some of the area's most sought after recreational amenities within easy reach. Whether you're gathered around the fire on a snowy winter evening, enjoying the fresh mountain air from the deck, or spending the day on the lake with family and friends, this Thunderbird offers the kind of authentic mountain experience that never goes out of style.

results.remarks: Experience a level of refinement rarely found in Lake Arrowhead, where timeless design, intentional craftsmanship, and true pride of ownership converge at 26623 Hillcrest Lane. Located within the coveted Arrowhead Woods enclave and offering full lake rights, this is not simply a renovated home... it's a thoughtfully curated mountain retreat designed to stand the test of time.From the moment you step inside, the difference is unmistakable. This is not a trend driven design, it's enduring, organic, and effortlessly sophisticated. A comprehensive, high-end renovation was completed with the intention of creating a forever home, utilizing premium materials such as rich birch flooring, natural stone surfaces, and a cohesive palette that evokes a calm, elevated mountain lifestyle.At the heart of the home lies a truly exceptional kitchen. Expansive, open, and designed for both everyday living and large scale entertaining. Outfitted with top tier GE Cafe appliances, designer fixtures, and abundant workspace, it seamlessly connects to the main living areas, creating a natural flow for gathering and hosting.The main level showcases a grand great room with soaring cathedral ceilings, a striking stone fireplace, and an inviting warmth that defines mountain luxury. A second, generously sized family room below offers additional living space with its own fireplace, ideal for guests, multi-generational living, or relaxed evenings in.Four spacious bedrooms and three beautifully appointed bathrooms provide comfort and flexibility, while multiple decks including a wraparound Trex-style deck and a secondary entertaining deck invite you to take in the surrounding woodland views from nearly every angle. Large windows throughout frame the natural setting, giving the home a true ''living in the treetops'' experience. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac within a level, walkable neighborhood bordering the golf course, the location offers both privacy and accessibility with no through traffic, an increasingly rare combination in the area. Dual garages at street level add convenience, while the property still offers potential for expansion or the addition of an ADU.Additional features include dual-pane windows, updated systems, and a Flo smart water monitoring system for peace of mind. Homes of this caliber, where design, quality, and setting align so effortlessly are few and far between. And while the photos are compelling, this is one that truly reveals its full impact in person.

results.remarks: Design forward, extensively updated and set against one of Lake Arrowhead’s most compelling ridgeline views, The Tollhouse is a modern mountain classic, beautifully reimagined without losing its original character. With lake rights, level parking for three vehicles and two expansive decks, this three story retreat is made for effortless mountain living. Soaring wood clad ceilings, exposed beams and a dramatic wall of glass define the main living space, while an impressive stone fireplace brings warmth and mountain character. The completely remodeled kitchen features soft white cabinetry, stone countertops, floating wood shelving and warm gold details. New sliding glass doors open the living room to the deck and sweeping ridgeline beyond, where fog rolls through the treetops below. The king primary suite is conveniently located on the main level with a fully remodeled en suite bath and statement shower featuring designer tilework. Upstairs, a queen bedroom, generous bunk room, loft and 3/4 bath provide plenty of space for family and guests. Downstairs, an expansive game room with bar and its own deck offers incredible flexibility for entertaining, a second living space or additional guest suite. A half bath and dedicated laundry room with new washer and dryer complete the level. Recent improvements include new central air conditioning, three new mini splits, recessed lighting in the kitchen and game room, and resealed windows. Outside, mornings begin with miles of forest and evenings are made for roasting marshmallows around the fire as the sun fades behind the ridgeline and fog drifts through the trees. Offered fully furnished, The Tollhouse boasts an impeccable short term rental history and consistent five star guest ratings, equally suited as a private Lake Arrowhead retreat, full time residence or proven hospitality offering.

The main level primary suite creates a private sanctuary, complete with a spa-like bathroom designed for relaxation after a day at the lake or on the trails. At the heart of the home, you'll find both a separate family room & a dedicated den, connected by a striking two-sided fireplace that adds warmth & character to each space.
